title: Fixed Inclined Collector and Open Tray Cabinet
description: One newly authored whole static agricultural drying-cabinet-style appearance. One full door is fixed completely open to the right; one common ground stand carries both volumes. Unlike the old low planting cold frame with raised glazed sash, there is no ground planting cavity or glass pane; unlike the front-drop oven there is a separate long inclined collector and upright chimney relationship, not a relabelled oven. All visible geometry newly authored, no imported old mesh. One model zero scenes.
